corrections.label: Cortex and white matter
corrections.anatomy_note: Whole hemispheres provide orientation only. Specific gyri, sulci and white-matter regions are not independently identified in this atlas.

corrections.label: Deep grey matter and capsules
corrections.anatomy_note: The current atlas does not separately represent the deep grey nuclei, internal capsule or corpus callosum. Ventricles must not be used as substitutes for these structures.

corrections.label: Brainstem and cerebellum
corrections.anatomy_note: Only gross cerebellar and fourth-ventricle context is highlighted. Brainstem subdivisions, cerebellar lobules and peduncles are not separately represented.

corrections.label: Vascular territory
corrections.anatomy_note: Whole hemispheres provide orientation only; these meshes do not define arterial territories, border zones or venous drainage.

corrections.label: Spinal cord and optic nerves
corrections.anatomy_note: The brain atlas does not contain the spinal cord or optic nerves. Review those structures on the relevant acquired images.

corrections.label: Central vein sign and rim lesions
corrections.anatomy_note: Central veins, paramagnetic rims and MS lesions are not represented in this atlas. Ventricular anatomy does not demonstrate these findings.

corrections.label: Dural sinuses
corrections.anatomy_note: The current brain atlas does not contain the dural venous sinuses.

corrections.label: Deep and cortical veins
corrections.anatomy_note: Deep and cortical veins are not represented in this atlas. Ventricles are not venous structures.

corrections.label: Mimics and comparison
corrections.anatomy_note: Venous variants and flow-related mimics are not represented in this anatomical atlas.

corrections.label: Dura and veins
corrections.anatomy_note: Dura and venous structures are not represented in this atlas.

corrections.label: Brain sagging
corrections.anatomy_note: Only gross cerebellar and fourth-ventricle context is highlighted. Brainstem landmarks and pathological sagging are not represented.

corrections.label: Subdural collections
corrections.anatomy_note: Hemisphere outlines provide orientation only; the dura and subdural collections are not represented.

corrections.label: Pituitary and supportive findings
corrections.anatomy_note: The pituitary gland and its disease-related changes are not represented in this atlas.

corrections.label: Spinal assessment
corrections.anatomy_note: The brain atlas does not show spinal anatomy, meningeal diverticula or a spinal CSF leak.
